authorization: 2026-10-28 사용자: BETA·CURE와 대표 그림을 모델 디자인 보고서에 추가하고 1·2안 코드를 작성
scope: Implement both report designs; unit contracts and a small synthetic integration run with the real frozen TabPFN backend. No IDS benchmark sweep or performance superiority claim is authorized by this implementation check.
data_contract: NPZ: X_l, y_l (integer class IDs), X_u (no labels), X_test; optional y_test read only for scoring, and disjoint ids_l/ids_u/ids_test. Categorical indices are explicit. Exact L/U feature overlap is rejected. Test overlap requires explicit historical-diagnostic flag.
proposal_a: Frozen PFN teacher, train-only numeric/categorical preprocessing, residual MLP and masked reconstruction, soft teacher+distance assignment with column-KL, confidence-weighted student adaptation, anchored prototypes/prior. Student-only deployment.
proposal_b: Full-label Global, exact-feature-group OOF, eligible pairs with >=3 unique groups per class, bounded log-odds residual, foldwise loss improvement and global benign-FP constraint, max 3 distinct experts. Missing Global-fold classes trigger complete fallback. No query retrieval or prior adjustment in the base implementation.
test_plan: Analytic assignment stationarity; teacher-independent deployment and export roundtrip; categorical/missing handling; group isolation; no extra labels; n=2 exact fallback; pair correction bounds and selected-expert branch; real PFN fit/predict/save/load and backbone digest invariance.
